raw_input: New open source app built from scratch (Next.js + NestJS, Postiz as reference): multi-network publishing (X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook) with calendar and per-network OAuth, daily AI news digest over chosen sources (X accounts, websites/RSS), React Native/Expo mobile app. Self-hosted single-user, private behind Tailscale on a Hostinger KVM 1 VPS. Built in public. Split into stages; this first cycle is stage 1: monorepo + X/LinkedIn publishing + composer + calendar + scheduler.
roadmap: mvp/core-publishing — monorepo, X + LinkedIn publishing, composer, calendar, scheduler
feature/news-digest — sources, AI research, drafts into the calendar
feature/mobile-app — Expo app: approve drafts, read digest, share-sheet drafts, push
open_questions: UI language (English + i18n vs Spanish first)
License: AGPL-3.0 vs MIT (before first code commit)
Default queue slots on fresh install
